Never kill court, foreign, medical or union criminals. Reasoning: in the worst case L traces every source and the timing. Two sources leave 1/16 of the population. Afternoon-only kills rule out day workers, leaving 55%. So 10M/16*0.55 = about 344k, which is safely above 200k. A third source would give about 86k, which means caught. Stick to the same two sources every day so no new information leaks. Announcements can be off by a factor of 3, so don't overreact. Only panic if the pool is consistently announced at 200k or below.
